rina: hey everyone, first day! hitting a wall installing ruby with asdf on my M2 macbook. gem native extensions fail with openssl errors. I tried:
```
RUBY_CONFIGURE_OPTS="--with-openssl-dir=$(brew --prefix openssl@3)" asdf install ruby 3.1.2
```
but it still bombs with `ld: library not found for -lssl`. also the 1password-cli auth in my devcontainer isn't persisting OP_SESSION, so i'm blocked on a few secrets :grimacing:. any quick checklist for apple-silicon dev bootstrap?

jordan: welcome rina! common issues: brew on M1 lives at /opt/homebrew, older ext might expect /usr/local. try installing openssl@1.1 too: `brew install openssl@1.1` then put its bin/include in your PATH during build. also make sure Xcode CLI tools are installed: `xcode-select --install`.

tara: also run `asdf reshim ruby` and then `asdf global ruby 3.1.2` after successful build. if you see mismatched arch errors it's often because parts of brew were installed under rosetta. check `brew --prefix` output (should be /opt/homebrew for arm). putting `export PATH="$(brew --prefix openssl@1.1)/bin:$PATH"` before `asdf install` helps.

rina: how do i check if my brew is running under rosetta vs native arm?

jordan: run `file $(which brew)` or just `uname -m` in the shell launched by your terminal. if `brew --prefix` returns `/usr/local` that's the intel install. for rosetta brew you might see `/usr/local` and `arch` will say i386/x86_64.

tara: for the devcontainer + 1password-cli: either sign in inside the container to create OP_SESSION, or better, use the host's 1p session by mapping `~/.op` and adding `OP_SESSION_...` to your container env in devcontainer.json via secrets. don't commit those. we have a short doc in the onboarding guide: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/dev-env (see "Secrets & 1Password").

onboarding-bot: Tip: put local overrides in `.env.local` or `secrets.local` and add to .gitignore. If you need access to the mac provisioning image, ping tara.

rina: awesome, thanks folks — trying openssl@1.1 + PATH tweak now. i'll update this thread if anything else pops up. also tagging tara for the provisioning image question :wave:

tara: got you — i'll DM the provisioning script and the MDM instructions. gl with the install! :rocket:
